faq.question: Can I reschedule my cleaning appointment?
faq.answer: Yes, you can reschedule your cleaning appointment by contacting our customer service at least 24 hours in advance.

faq.question: Do I need to provide cleaning equipment?
faq.answer: No, our cleaners come equipped with all the necessary cleaning supplies and equipment.

faq.question: What areas do you cover for home cleaning?
faq.answer: We provide home cleaning services in [insert covered areas]. Please check with our customer service for specific locations.

details: Our plumbing and sanitary services include a wide range of solutions for your plumbing needs. From fixing leaks and clogs to installing new fixtures, our experienced plumbers are here to help. Our services cover both residential and commercial properties.

pricing.policy: Prices are based on standard service rates. Additional charges may apply for emergency services or extensive repairs.
pricing.payment: Payment is due upon completion of the service. We accept cash, credit/debit cards, and digital payment methods.

noteToCustomer.preparation: Before service starts, make sure the water lines, gas lines, and other utilities are turned off.
noteToCustomer.delayCharge: If any delay happens by the customer, there will be an extra charge added to the service price.
noteToCustomer.complaintPolicy: After delivering the service, the customer must cross-check the work before the service person leaves the premises. No complaints will be accepted after the service person has left.
noteToCustomer.belongings: Make sure to keep expensive belongings in a safe place.
noteToCustomer.waterElectricity: Customers need to provide access to fresh water and electricity to support the service person.
noteToCustomer.extraCharge: If the work area increases or additional services are requested, extra charges may apply.
noteToCustomer.noOtherWork: Ensure no other work is being carried out in the premises during the service.
